id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1810: "That you and I met must also be Yggdrasil's will.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1894: "Entrust yourself to the flow of time. If Yggdrasil wills it, we will surely meet again.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1958: "Luminary {var:1}, I pray for your safe journey. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b44: "...Hehe, I see. Then let me tell you about the mysterious power I see ahead of you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f40: "...Hehe, I see. Then let me tell you about the mysterious power I see ahead of you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2318: "...Hehe, I see. Then let me tell you about the mysterious power I see ahead of you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26f4: "...Hehe, I see. Then let me tell you about the mysterious power I see ahead of you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bf4: "...Far to the west. Beyond the pillar of light rising from the sea lies a lively place where girls gather.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cd8: "The master of that place is very mysterious, but I think not a bad person. I'm sure she'll welcome you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dbc: "This is as far as I could see. Where you go is up to you. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2198: "This is as far as I could see. Where you go is up to you. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|258c: "This is as far as I could see. Where you go is up to you. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2890: "This is as far as I could see. Where you go is up to you. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ff0: "...Far to the west. Where the pillar of light rising from the sea guides you, there's a village by ancient ruins.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20d4: "If you go to those ruins, you may gain a magical power that opens the door to new adventures.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23c8: "...In the northeast, amid golden wheat fields, someone at a small inn seems to remember a fallen country.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24f8: "If you speak with them, you may obtain what you seek.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a4: "...In the northwest, in a kingdom of wisdom, I sensed a freezing power. What you seek must be there.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29f4: "...Hehe, though I say so, my guidance isn't needed by you now.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a94: "For now, aim for the center of the world. The First Forest altar embracing Yggdrasil is the key to your path.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ba8: "I pray for your safe journey. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e54: "I pray for your safe journey. All under Yggdrasil's guidance.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cd8: "...Hehe, I'm glad. If you ever need anything, please visit my kingdom, Nautica.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d84: "I can use a bit of magic. It may serve as a guidepost for your adventure.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fc4: "There isn't much time. ...Touch the Farsight pearl.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30c8: "First, let me thank you. Thank you for defeating Jarvis and taking back our sea.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3180: "Thanks to you, the flame of hope on the seabed, nearly gone, burns brightly again.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|322c: "Never forget, even though Yggdrasil has fallen, its will lives in you. Simply walk the path you believe in.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3324: "Well then, Luminary {var:1}. I pray for your safe journey. All under Yggdrasil's guidance...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3460: "The day Yggdrasil rose again, its gentle light reached the undersea kingdom too, telling us the Dark One had fallen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|355c: "There are no words for this joy, on land or under the sea. ...I offer you my heartfelt thanks.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|362c: "Now, Luminary {var:1}. Your long, long journey is about to come to an end.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36dc: "Someday... let's talk at leisure. Tell me about the world you saw at the end of your long journey.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3830: "The monster that stole the Farsight pearl's radiance is Death Aegir... It lurks near the isolated northeast island.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3920: "Sail near the island and your Mermaid harp will signal Death Aegir's presence.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|39e4: "Now... Luminary {var:1}, defeat Death Aegir and restore the Farsight pearl's radiance!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3b98: "Our Queen was a tomboy, going to the surface to fight birds and humans, and coming home covered in scratches...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c84: "Curiosity is good, but please in moderation, or my heart may stop.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d98: "Humans on land, fish in the sea... different species, yet to Lady Seren they're surely equal lives.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e98: "Our Queen Seren is a mermaid of such great capacity. I'm proud of her.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fc8: "It has been hundreds of years since the door to the Sea of the Guardians opened for anyone but royal mermaids...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4098: "That is how much Queen Seren wishes to tell the Luminary. Please proceed with care.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41a0: "The Queen is gathering the people of the undersea kingdom for an important speech, and asks that the Luminary attend.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4284: "The speech will be held outside the palace. There's no time to dawdle. Please hurry.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43a4: "I have served Lady Seren since she was a tiny child who couldn't swim steadily.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4448: "That tiny Lady Seren now overcomes the greatest crisis since the undersea kingdom began... Splendid.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|452c: "As the undersea kingdom's minister, I am proud.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4608: "Since the Dark One appeared, Lady Seren seemed to blame herself for being unable to help the world.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46ec: "When did I last see such a bright smile... I can't thank you enough.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|478c: "Visit the undersea kingdom again anytime. You're always welcome!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|484c: "Welcome. I have a favor to ask of you, Luminary. Please hear it from Lady Seren.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|491c: "Death Aegir is truly a tough foe. I pray for your fortune, Luminary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49f8: "Defeating Death Aegir like filleting a fish. As expected of the Luminary! It seems my worries were unneeded.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b78: "Welcome, Luminary. The Queen awaits in the throne room.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4bfc: "Go through the door in the upper part of the palace and you'll reach the throne room right away.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4ca4: "I'd like to help you, but if you don't move your body, your fine tail fin will go dull.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d60: "Please climb to the throne by yourself. It's training, Luminary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4edc: "Please climb to the throne by yourself. It's training, Luminary.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e34: "...Making a cute face won't work. If you don't move your body, your fine tail fin will go dull.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fc8: "Luminary, you look well~. The Queen is waiting in the throne room~. Go see her soon~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50e8: "I don't know what lies beyond the Sea of the Guardians either~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5164: "Entering a place only past queens may enter is such an honor~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5308: "...What am I doing? Can't you tell? Fishing. As head chef I, the great me, supply the palace meals.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5714: "...What am I doing? Can't you tell? Fishing. As head chef I, the great me, supply the palace meals.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|53f4: "What? Staring at me. You humans eat fish but don't fish? Strange creatures.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|54fc: "...What am I doing? Obvious, isn't it? Fishing, fishing. As head chef I, the great me, supply the palace meals.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|55f8: "Mister, your scales are an unusual color. Your belly pattern too... Can I taste just one fin?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5800: "...Lately fish are hard to catch down here, and I'm in a pinch. Is it because the world is in chaos?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5918: "The fish not biting must be Death Aegir's fault. What an outrageous guy.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|59c0: "You're going to take him out on the Queen's request, right? I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ae4: "Strange? I heard you beat Death Aegir and was hopeful, but I still can't catch any fish.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5b98: "Could it be that something else is still causing trouble in the sea? Maybe that's why I'm skunked.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5c30: "...Don't say it's because of my skill. I don't want to hear it.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5da8: "The Queen's whims are a trouble. Letting a human into the kingdom, what is she thinking...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e84: "Are you really the Queen's guest? Make one suspicious move and I'll make sure you never enter the kingdom again.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fb8: "We've been waiting, Luminary who was once human. This is the undersea palace. Queen Seren awaited your awakening.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60a0: "The Queen is in the throne room. She'll be delighted, so show her you swim vigorously.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6268: "...You alone are the last remaining hope of us sea folk. I pray for your fortune.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|635c: "...Luminary. You alone are the last hope of us sea folk. I pray for your fortune.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|646c: "Hm... a human. You may visit the Queen, but don't try anything suspicious in this undersea kingdom.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6538: "Even a guest of the Queen won't be spared if you do something dangerous. Remember that well.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6634: "I heard! You defeated that Death Aegir! Well, impressive.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|66bc: "The sea will be a bit more peaceful now. It seems the Queen was right to invite you to the kingdom.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6880: "I'm sorry! I'm sorry~! I'll apologize so don't eat me! Don't spear me with a harpoon~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6974: "Human, I'll tell you something useful, so spare me~! Don't spear me with a harpoon~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6a08: "Besides the undersea kingdom's entrance, there are many shining pillars of light above the sea~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6abc: "Some mysterious places have a pillar of light in the sea that connects to a lake on a big continent~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6bd8: "Lately the kingdom feels strange... From afar there's a grating clank! clank! sound.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c8c: "I told everyone in the kingdom, but they say I'm just a worrywart coward and no one pays attention...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6dc4: "Aaah! My body is all fat! I don't taste good at all!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e4c: "...Don't scare me like that! You're just a normal fish! Calling from behind made me think you were a shark!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f84: "I'm a coward, but when I grow up I want to be a strong, brave man like the Luminary!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|703c: "First I plan to train not to scream thinking it's a shark when called from behind!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7158: "Aaah! My body is all fat! If you eat me you'll get heartburn and indigestion!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|71e0: "...Don't scare me like that! It's the Luminary! Calling from behind made me think you were a shark!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|72f8: "Y-you startled me. I was walking lost in thought and didn't notice you...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7440: "...You scared me! It reminds me of when a shark attacked me long ago, so please don't!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7650: "I'm the housekeeper of this house. The master is a very beautiful mermaid named Romia.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7700: "It's a secret from the other fish, but you look human, so I'll tell you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7784: "Actually, a human man is about to move into this house. Romia promised to marry him.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7874: "Humans are a bit scary, but if Romia loves him he must be a good man. I'm looking forward to it.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7990: "...I heard from the Queen. Romia won't be coming home.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a00: "But I've decided. Every day I'll clean the room, decorate with coral, and polish the shells until they shine.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7ac4: "If I keep the house clean, I feel I can recall Romia's happy smile anytime.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bbc: "Romia often told me that not all humans are bad. Some are kind and gentle.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c88: "Everyone says it's dangerous, but someday I want to go to the surface and talk to humans.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d88: "What Romia said was true. You are a human, but kind, gentle, and brave.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e50: "Thank you so much for taking back the undersea kingdom!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7f20: "With or without the Dark One, the undersea kingdom's beauty and the fishes' lives haven't changed much.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7fe8: "Maybe peace is just ordinary days you can't see...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|80b4: "Even if the house has no owner, I never skip cleaning. She might come back someday.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8284: "I'm 240 this year, but talking with a human is my first time. You're the Queen's guest everyone's talking about, aren't you?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|834c: "You can breathe on the seabed thanks to magic only the Queen can use. A grand welcome from the sea currents!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8434: "The Queen waits for you in the throne room at the top of the innermost palace~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|853c: "I sometimes stroll outside the kingdom! My favorite is the sea of Sniflheim, where snow dances!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8608: "There's a pillar of light where cold water flows in, perfect for swimming on hot days~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8718: "The undersea kingdom has unusual sights! Fish Tavern, the National Museum, the Deep Sea Court! ...I could go on forever!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|881c: "Best of all is the undersea palace right ahead! The castle of our beautiful Queen!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8a00: "Human or mermaid, it makes no difference! Good goods, good morning, good weather! Shop away!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8b68: "Well, I'll be! The human traveler from before has come as a fish this time!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c08: "Then I'll show you specialties sold only to mermaids. Take your time shopping!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d58: "Human, mermaid, sea folk, no difference! You're our hero! Shop away!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8f7c: "Mermaid songs have healing power. You look pretty tired, so want to hear my song?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9068: "I see. Don't push yourself too hard. If you tire, call me anytime.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|913c: The mermaid's gentle voice echoed around.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9240: "At the Queen's request I let you stay at my inn, but recovering from those wounds is a miracle!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9318: "The Queen sang healing songs every night to you, tormented by pain. You were saved thanks to her.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9468: "That battered little fish is the Luminary who saves the world, how surprising. I'm proud to have lodged you!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9538: "Once you bring peace to the world, advertise how comfy my beds are. Well then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9694: "That battered little fish really saved the world, how surprising. I'm proud to have lodged you!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|975c: "It may not be long before my inn is told of as the Luminary's favorite, a legendary inn. Well then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|995c: "This is the undersea kingdom Nautica. A paradise under the sea ruled by a beautiful mermaid queen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9a7c: "Oh, Luminary, I'm glad you woke. You've been asleep ever since you fell to the seabed.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9d58: "Oh, Luminary, I'm glad you woke. You've been asleep ever since you fell to the seabed.

tm.「まずは お礼を言わせてください。\n ジャコラを倒し わたくしたちの海を\n: "First, let me thank you. Thank you for defeating Jarvis and taking back our sea.

tm.「この よろこびをあらわす言葉は\n 地上にも 海底にもありません。\n ……心: "There are no words for this joy, on land or under the sea. ...I offer you my heartfelt thanks.
tm.「さて 勇者 {var:1}。\n あなたの 長い 長い旅は\n まもなく終わり: "Now, Luminary {var:1}. Your long, long journey is about to come to an end.
tm.「いつの日か……ゆっくり お話ししましょう。\n 長い 長い 旅の先に見た世界の: "Someday... let's talk at leisure. Tell me about the world you saw at the end of your long journey.
tm.「千里の真珠から かがやきを奪った\n 魔物の名は デスエーギル……。\n 外海: "The monster that stole the Farsight pearl's radiance is Death Aegir... It lurks near the isolated northeast island.
